title: OrchestrationMessage
description: A single task sent to, or response sent from, an APYROBO orchestration server. See spec/wire-protocol.md.

task.description: Natural-language task description. The only field a client is required to send.

robot_uri.description: Target robot URI, e.g. mock://turtlebot4. Defaulted by the server when absent.

metadata.description: Free-form on requests. On responses, carries the result.

status.description: Response outcome. "planned" or "error" in spec 1.0; consumers must ignore unknown values.

skills.description: Present when status is "planned": the ordered skill plan.

count.description: Present when status is "planned": number of skills in the plan.

error.description: Present when status is "error": human-readable failure reason.

spec.description: Optional: the spec version the sender implements, e.g. "1.0".

source.description: Sender identifier. The reference server sets "orchestration_server" on responses.
